description: B2B or B2C SaaS with a data dashboard at its core. Industry brain defines the domain. This core defines how the SaaS product is structured and experienced.

three_js.description: Grid of floating vertical bars animating up and down like a live chart. Gold or blue accent bars pulse brighter. Financial data energy.
three_js.avoid: no status pills, no hero-stat-line, no ticker strips

relationships: Organisation has many Users with Roles
User belongs to Organisation with a Role (admin, member, viewer)
Project belongs to Organisation, contains Records
Record is the core data unit — its definition varies by industry (patient, property, loan, shipment, etc.)
Report is generated from Records and Metrics
Metric is a computed value from Records
Integration connects the Organisation to external services
Team is a subset of Users within an Organisation
AuditLog records all actions by Users
Subscription defines the plan and feature access for an Organisation
Notification belongs to User, triggered by system events or thresholds

mvp.description: Core SaaS — login, dashboard overview, record management, basic reporting.
primary_flows: Sign up → create organisation → invite team → set up project → add records → view dashboard
Log in → view dashboard → browse records → view record detail → take action
View dashboard metrics → identify issue → navigate to relevant records

layout.notes: Data density is a feature not a bug. Sidebar always present on desktop — never hamburger on desktop. On iPhone sidebar becomes bottom tab — never a hamburger either.

avoid: Never use a bottom tab nav on desktop — sidebar only
Never use photography or lifestyle imagery anywhere in the product
Never use a pie chart for more than 4 categories — use a bar chart instead
Never truncate KPI card numbers — show full value or use abbreviation (10.2K) never ellipsis
Never use red for anything except error states and negative trends — it triggers alarm
Never put more than 5 items in the sidebar primary nav
Never use a modal for record creation — use a side panel or dedicated screen
Never auto-refresh data without warning — always show 'Last updated X ago' with manual refresh
Never use gradients on charts — flat fills only for clarity
enforce: KPI cards always show: metric name, value, trend indicator (up/down arrow), percentage change
Trend up in green, trend down in red — no exceptions in B2B data context
Table rows always have hover state — subtle background shift
Pagination or infinite scroll on all tables — never show all rows without limit
Filter and sort always accessible without leaving the current screen
Export button always present on any table or chart — CSV minimum
Role-based access states — admin sees everything, viewer sees read-only, manager sees subset
All timestamps in user's local timezone — never UTC without conversion
Search available on every records list — keyboard shortcut Cmd/Ctrl+K

empty_states.ui: KPI cards show with placeholder values and 'Connect your data' CTA. Chart areas show illustrated placeholder with setup instructions. Never show zero values as if they're real.
Table shows column headers. Body shows single row with illustration and: 'No [records] yet'. CTA: 'Create your first [record]'. Import option shown secondary.

empty_states.trigger: No data in selected date range
empty_states.ui: Chart area shows: 'No data for this period'. Date range selector highlighted. Suggest adjacent period with data available.

empty_states.trigger: Search or filter returns no results
empty_states.ui: Empty state inline in table: 'No results match your filters'. Show active filters above with 'Clear all' option. Never collapse the filter bar.

loading_states.ui: KPI cards load first with skeleton shimmer — same size as real cards. Charts below load after — skeleton rectangle in chart area. Data table skeleton: column headers visible, 5 row skeletons below.
Table header and filter bar visible and interactive immediately. Rows show skeleton shimmer. Page count shows skeleton.
Chart skeleton — grey rectangle exact size of chart. Data table skeleton below. Never show old data during reload — always show skeleton.

error_flows.ui: Banner at top of dashboard: 'Data sync failed — showing data from [time]'. Retry button inline. KPI values shown with warning icon indicating they may be stale.
Form remains open. Red inline error at top of form. Specific field errors shown inline. Data not lost — user can retry or copy content.
Toast: 'Export failed. Please try again.' Retry button in toast. If large export — offer to email when ready instead.
Action button shows with lock icon. Clicking shows tooltip: 'You need [role] access to do this. Contact your admin.' Never show a generic 403 page.

edge_cases.ui: Pagination enforced. Page size selector: 25/50/100 rows. Server-side search — not client-side filter. Export shows warning: 'Large export may take a few minutes'.
Optimistic lock — last save wins. Conflict notification: '[User] also edited this record. Your changes were saved.' Show diff option.
Show as a KPI card instead of a chart. A chart with one point is meaningless — degrade gracefully.
Show negative sign clearly. Red colour. Down arrow. Never use parentheses for negative — use minus sign.
